Variants.Content: Upper Rhine routes, former Roman borderland and woods toward the Danube give Segodunum connections and obstacles. Few crossings matter disproportionately, and neighboring war forces merchants into detours.

Segodunum connects the upper Rhine and woods toward the Danube. Travelers and guards use specific banks, entrances and stops; outward access does not ensure return. Few crossings make neighboring war a cause of detours.

Few crossings make neighboring war a cause of detours. Passage relations need actual protection for adjoining sections; proximity does not equal a shared guarantee. Segodunum connects the upper Rhine and woods toward the Danube.

Segodunum connects the upper Rhine and woods toward the Danube. Closed routes may separate families from goods, imposing costs on those remaining at home. Few crossings make neighboring war a cause of detours.
